kv20.3:2.1: Atthi manussesu kammakāraṇā, atthi ca kāraṇikā ti?
kv20.3:2.3: Atthi nirayesu kammakāraṇā, atthi ca kāraṇikā ti?
kv20.3:2.5: Atthi nirayesu kammakāraṇā, n' atthi ca kāraṇikā ti?
kv20.3:2.7: Atthi manussesu kammakāraṇā, n' atthi ca kāraṇikā ti?
kv20.3:5.3: Tena hi n' atthi nirayesu nirayapālā ti. 4.
kv20.3:6.4: "Taṃ enaṃ Bhikkhave nirayapālā pañcavidhabandhanaṃ nāma kāraṇaṃ kārenti,
kv20.3:6.5: tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ hatthe gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ dutiye hatthe gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ pāde gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ dutiye pāde gamenti, tattaṃ ayokhīlaṃ majjhe urasmiṃ gamenti;
kv20.3:6.6: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vedeti,
kv20.3:6.7: na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byanti hotīti."
kv20.3:6.10: Tena hi atthi nirayesu nirayapālā ti. 5.
kv20.3:7.4: "Taṃ enaṃ Bhikkhave nirayapālā saṃvesitvā kudhārīhi tacchanti,
kv20.3:7.5: taṃ enaṃ Bhikkhave nirayapālā uddhaṃ pādaṃ adhosiraṃ ṭhapetvā vāsīhi tacchanti,
kv20.3:7.6: taṃ enaṃ Bhikkhave nirayapālā rathe yojetvā ādiṭṭāya paṭhaviyā sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya sārenti pi paccā sārenti pi,
kv20.3:7.7: taṃ enaṃ Bhikkhave nirayapālā mahantaṃ Aṅgārapabbataṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ āropenti pi oropenti pi,
kv20.3:7.8: taṃ enaṃ Bhikkhave nirayapālā uddhaṃ pādaṃ adhosiraṃ gahetvā tattāya lohakumbhiyā pakkhipanti ādiṭṭāya sampajjalitāya sajotibhūtāya,
kv20.3:7.9: so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccati, so tattha pheṇuddehakaṃ paccamāno sakiṃ pi uddhaṃ gacchati sakiṃ pi adho gacchati, sakiṃ pi tiriyaṃ gacchati,
kv20.3:7.10: so tattha dukkhā tibbā kaṭukā vedanā vedayati na ca tāva kālaṃ karoti yāva ca na taṃ pāpakammaṃ byanti hoti,
kv20.3:7.11: tam enaṃ Bhikkhave nirayapālā mahāniraye pakkhipanti.
kv20.3:10.3: Tena hi atthi nirayesu nirayapālā ti.
